title: Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino (Theme 11: Uwekezaji)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child drops the n- or ny- of the noun and adds ji-/ju- for the big form and ki- for the small form, then gives LI-YA or KI-VI agreement.

floor.prerequisite: Makes big forms of m- nouns.
floor.question: Ukubwa wa mti ni?

representations: drawings: a house, a mansion, a hut
contexts: investment: a big building in town

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ukubwa wa "nyumba" ni ___." Kwa nini "jinyumba" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za n- hubadilika kwa kuondoa sauti ya mwanzo: nyumba - jumba, kijumba. Baadhi huongeza ji- (mbwa - jibwa).

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Udogo wa "nyumba" ni ___." Kwa nini "jumba" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ki- huonyesha udogo: kijumba. Ukubwa huonyeshwa na ji- au umbo la pekee kama jumba.
Jumba ni la LI-YA: jumba limejengwa.
